text: 周五（10月2日）欧市尾盘，德国10年期国债收益率跌4.6个基点，报3.462%，整体呈现出V形走势、北京时间20:30发布美国非农就业报告之前持续扩大跌幅、20:32刷新日低至3.374%、随后逐步收复失地，本周累计下跌14.0个基点，9月28-30日高位窄幅震荡于3.6%附近，10月1-2日持续下挫。 两年期德债收益率涨1.2个基点，报3.076%，低位震荡行情中、20:32刷新日低至2.949%，随后持续反弹，本周累跌20.2个基点，整体持续下跌；30年期德债收益率跌7.5个基点，报3.819%，本周累跌9个基点。 2/10年期德债收益率利差跌5.
text_en: Friday (October 2) late in the European session, the yield on the 10-year German government bond fell 4.6 basis points to 3.462%, showing an overall V-shaped trend, continuously widening losses before the U.S. nonfarm payrolls report was released at 20:30 Beijing time, refreshing a daily low of 3.374% at 20:32, and then gradually recovering losses; for the week, it fell 14.0 basis points cumulatively, fluctuating narrowly at high levels around 3.6% from September 28-30, and continuing to decline from October 1-2. The yield on the 2-year German government bond rose 1.2 basis points to 3.076%, fluctuating at low levels, refreshing a daily low of 2.949% at 20:32, then continuing to rebound; for the week, it fell 20.2 basis points cumulatively, declining continuously overall; the yield on the 30-year German government bond fell 7.5 basis points to 3.819%, down 9 basis points cumulatively for the week. The 2/10-year German government bond yield spread fell 5.
